dispositions.span_text: In addition to the requirements of Section 6.2, Antares and AMAG shall each maintain such records in compliance with Applicable Laws as is reasonably necessary to permit a Recall of any Products, sample Products and Trainers delivered to AMAG, AMAG's designee or customers of AMAG.

Each Party shall promptly (but no later than [***] of receipt of such information) notify the other by telephone (to be confirmed in writing) of any information which might affect the marketability, safety, or effectiveness of the Products, sample Products or Trainers and/or which might result in the Recall or seizure of the Products, sample Products, or Trainers.

Upon receiving any such notice or upon any such discovery, each Party shall cease and desist from further shipments of such Products, sample Products or Trainers in its possession or control until a decision by AMAG has been made whether a Recall or some other corrective action is necessary.

observations.note:
NEAR-MISS, DELIBERATELY NOT COUNTED as instance three of the multi-element temporal composition finding (instances one and two: C04-051#temporal-composition, C04-072#temporal-composition).

WHAT IS SIMILAR. Item C02-07's sentence carries TWO temporal elements: the annotated 'Upon receiving any such notice or upon any such discovery' (RELATIVE_TO_TRIGGER) and a terminal bound, 'until a decision by AMAG has been made whether a Recall or some other corrective action is necessary', which classifies to None on its own (verified by execution). IR v1 holds one temporal, so the terminal bound is unrepresented.

WHY THE MECHANISM IS DIFFERENT, which is the whole reason it is not counted. In instances one and two the surplus bounds sit INSIDE the phrase the model quotes and are SWALLOWED by a greedy '(.+)$' capture, so the candidate COMPILES SILENTLY with a trigger string asserting a wrong window -- that silent misstatement is the finding. Here the terminal bound sits OUTSIDE the annotated temporal phrase entirely: nothing is swallowed, nothing silently misstates the window, and the duration is simply absent from the IR. That is ordinary single-temporal-slot loss, not the greedy-capture defect.

WHY IT IS LOGGED ANYWAY. Padding an instance count with a superficially similar but mechanistically different case would corrupt the very forcing function those instances exist to trigger -- a future ruling session counting three would be reasoning from a contaminated sample. Recorded so the case is FINDABLE and its exclusion is auditable, rather than invisible. Reviewer-confirmed 2026-09-20.

SEARCH KEY: temporal composition near-miss, not-an-instance, terminal bound outside the phrase, C02-047, C02-07.

SUPERSEDED IN PART, 2026-09-23 -- F21, guideline v0.63, §8.12. THIS SPAN'S ITEM (C02-07) IS NOW TAGGED temporal_composition, AND THE NOTE ABOVE IS RIGHT ABOUT THE MECHANISM AND WRONG ABOUT WHAT FOLLOWS FROM IT. Its mechanical observation stands and was re-verified: the terminal bound sits OUTSIDE the annotated temporal phrase, nothing is swallowed, nothing silently misstates the window, and 'until a decision by AMAG has been made...' classifies to None on its own. Its reason for not counting this as instance three also stands: padding the count would have corrupted the very forcing function the instances exist to trigger, and the count behind the amendment is still TWO. WHAT THE RULING SEPARATES is the question the note ran together -- what counts as an INSTANCE for the forcing function versus what falls in the TAG'S SCOPE. §8.12 is scoped by the SLOT LIMIT (the source states two temporal elements constraining the duty differently; ast.Obligation holds one), and the greedy '(.+)$' swallow is a SYMPTOM confined to the cases where the surplus sits inside the quoted phrase -- not the defining condition. Scoping the tag by the swallow would make it record a CLASSIFIER ARTEFACT, which sits badly with kind REPRESENTATIONAL. So this case is in scope, was reviewer-ruled in on 2026-09-23, and is corrected here in place per the ruling's own instruction rather than left reading as an exclusion. NOTHING ABOUT THIS ITEM'S FIELDS CHANGES and the item is not restamped: it was already outside §9.1's in-force denominator on both of its existing tags, and it has no cassette.
